## About
Vasco Quick Lube is a neighborhood car care shop at the intersection of North Vasco Rd. and Scenic Ave. in Livermore, right on the commuter path. We handle oil changes, brakes, air conditioning service and almost any other maintenance item, plus smog and California Clean Truck Check inspections and general automotive repair.
We are a STAR certified smog test and repair station, we are authorized to perform state funded CAP repairs, and we service all makes and models.
While you wait, you can relax in our air conditioned waiting room or walk to nearby restaurants, salons, Starbucks Coffee or a convenience store.

## Services
- Full service oil change: Oil, lube and filter, with fluids checked and topped off, windshields cleaned and tire pressure set.
- Synthetic, high mileage and diesel oil changes: Conventional, syn-blend, high mileage, full synthetic and diesel oil, depending on what your vehicle needs.
- Smog inspections: Smog testing for cars, trucks, vans, diesels and RVs.
- California Clean Truck Check: Clean Truck Check inspections alongside our regular smog testing.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Service and repair for your vehicle's air conditioning system.
- Brakes: Brake service as part of our everyday car care.
- General automotive repair: Common repairs such as starters, fuel pumps, timing belts and water pumps, steering and suspension, and more.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. We specialize in servicing all makes and models.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at the intersection of North Vasco Rd. and Scenic Ave. in Livermore.

Q: Can I drop off used motor oil?
A: Yes. We accept uncontaminated used motor oil from the public during our normal business hours.
